figures.title: Choi
figures.caption: Figure 3. Epithelial annotations and RNA markers. (A) UMAP of 11,683 retained cells. (B) Dot area indicates gene detection within annotations. (C) Expression in 10,399 cells from four alveolar-labeled groups, normalized to 10,000 counts and log1p-transformed, including zeros. (D) Fractions among all retained cells. hAT2, AT2-like; cAT2, cycling AT2; DATP, damage-associated transient progenitor. Club/airway* is an exclusion annotation.

figures.title: Niethamer
figures.caption: Figure 4. Transitional occupancy and AT1 RNA distributions. (A) Transitional labels among 5,694 selected alveolar cells; each point is one animal. (B-E) Raw-count detection above zero for four genes within broad AT1-labeled cells, retaining all 25 animals. (F-G) Empirical cumulative distributions for Nnat and Gpm6a; one curve per animal, colored by harvest. Expression is log1p(count × 10,000 / total cell UMI), including zeros. The two distribution plots were selected after inspecting the results.

figures.title: Receptors
figures.caption: Figure 5. Human epithelial receptor context. Rows are source-defined states; row numbers identify eligible participant/sample units. Each unit/state has at least 50 cells, with at least three units per row. Color is log10(1 + median counts per million); dot area is median detection. Ctrl, control; IPF, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; Trans., transitional. These RNA measurements describe receptor context and do not predict agonist response.

figures.title: Wnt Pca
figures.caption: Figure 6. Expression patterns and library structure. (A) Gene-wise z scores; three libraries per source condition. Colors compare expression within each gene. CHIR is a GSK3 inhibitor used to modulate Wnt pathway activity. (B) PCA of all 18 libraries: PC1, 49.96%; PC2, 17.32% of variance. Colors identify conditions; labels mark separated libraries by accession suffix.

figures.title: Niche Landscape
figures.caption: Figure 7. Screen-wide context and the NKX2-1 comparison. Left: 195 shared target contrasts; each point is a target. Axes show plate-adjusted coefficients versus combined references in mean log2(TMM counts per million + 0.5) marker-panel units. Right: scores from 31 plate-1 technical wells: 19 TIGIT, eight tdTomato, and four NKX2-1-targeted wells. AT2 scores use mouse RNA; chemokine and wound-marker scores use human fibroblast RNA. TMM denotes trimmed mean of M values normalization.
